explains.金色: 像太阳的颜色，很亮的黄色。

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.why: 三里屯 is new Beijing: glass shops, cafés, bars; 国贸 to the south is the business district.

nodes.say: 我朋友说，国贸的银行里，有一个金色的东西，会动！
nodes.simpler: 银行里有一个金色的东西。
nodes.translate: A friend says in a bank at 国贸 there's something golden — and it moves!

nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 半信半疑 — half believing, half doubting. You can read it from its parts.

nodes.speaker: hero
nodes.translate: The towers of 国贸! Huge!
Hello! First time at 国贸?

nodes.say: 你七上八下吧？没事，没事！
nodes.translate: Butterflies in your stomach? Don't worry!
nodes.why: A 成语 📌: 七上八下 — seven up, eight down: a heart that won't settle.

nodes.translate: Hello! This is our 貔貅.

nodes.speaker: pixiu
nodes.say: 我喜欢金色的东西。你有吗？
nodes.translate: I like golden things. Have you got any?

words.explain: 像太阳的颜色，很亮的黄色。

nodes.speaker: pixiu
nodes.why: A 貔貅 eats gold and never lets it out — chocolate in gold paper will do.

nodes.translate: Hi! What can I get you?
These chocolate coins? Ten yuan. Here.

nodes.say: 你知道共享单车吗？扫码，能骑。很快！
nodes.translate: Know the shared bikes? Scan the code and ride. Fast!
nodes.why: The bike stands are by the stations and in the lanes. Tap one to ride; tap a stand again (or go indoors) to park — 1 元 a ride.

words.explain: 在路边，大家都能用的车。

steps.now: 兔儿爷: a spirit that loves gold would go where the money is. Start at 三里屯 — line 10 to 团结湖.
Ask around 三里屯 — the parcel courier hears everything.
Ride line 10 south to 国贸 and go into the bank on the plaza.
The 貔貅 loves golden things. The convenience store 便利店 next to the bank sells chocolate coins in gold paper.
Give the golden coins to the 貔貅 in the bank's hall.
兔儿爷 wants to see the Bird's Nest: line 8 north to 奥林匹克公园.
The courier says: scan a shared bike 共享单车 at a stand and ride. Try one — park at any stand.

spirits.en: the pixiu, the beast that keeps wealth

legend.zh: 貔貅是金色的神兽。它很喜欢吃金子。人们说，它只吃，不拉，所以家里的钱不会走。很多银行和商店都有一个貔貅。
legend.en: The pixiu is a golden beast that loves to eat gold. People say it only eats and never lets anything out, so wealth stays in the house — many banks and shops keep one.

befriend.text: 我喜欢金色的东西。你有吗？

story.zh: 一个人跟你说一件事，你有一点信，也有一点不信，就是半信半疑。
story.en: When someone tells you something and you half believe it and half don't — that is 半信半疑.

idioms.meaning: on tenterhooks; your heart going up and down with nerves

story.zh: 心里好像有十五个水桶，七个上去，八个下来，很不安。
story.en: As if fifteen buckets were in your heart, seven going up and eight coming down — you can't settle.
